video_prompt.prompt: Southern European or mixed-ethnicity woman, late 20s to early 30s, warm sun-tanned skin with natural sun pigmentation — irregular melanin clustering across nose bridge and upper cheeks, varying depths some near-invisible, not cosmetic freckles. Medium brown hair pulled into a messy high bun — loose strands falling at temples and nape, natural frizz on top, bun not perfectly round, slight sun-bleached lighter strands visible at crown. Green-hazel eyes with visible iris texture and depth, natural lashes, slight asymmetry between eyes. Visible pores on nose and inner cheeks, natural sebum sheen on T-zone, sun-warmed glow on nose bridge and cheekbones from direct outdoor light, slight redness at nose tip, natural under-eye shadow. Wearing leopard print and tropical floral bikini top with gold ring hardware at center, gold Van Cleef style clover necklace layered, gold clover drop earrings, gold Van Cleef clover bracelet on wrist. She is reclined on a sun lounger with a teal/dark green beach towel draped over it, tropical resort setting — lush palm trees, large tropical leaves, wooden pergola structure behind, bright direct tropical sun overhead. Shot on iPhone front camera, arm-extended selfie angle, slight high angle. Bright tropical midday sun — strong direct light on face and chest, natural sun shadows under nose and chin, warm golden skin tone amplified by direct sunlight. Do not smooth skin. No beauty filter. Preserve exact facial identity, sun pigmentation, jewelry, and bikini throughout entire video.

script.line_2: Look — we're live right now, and they really wanna see you… say hello.

0-2s.action: She is relaxed and reclined, not fixed or posed — head turns slightly to the left off camera, casual and warm. She shifts her body weight naturally on the lounger, one shoulder rolling forward slightly. Her hand drops away from her face completely — resting on her chest or the towel beside her. She calls out with a relaxed half-smile, eyes soft and expectant, glancing off to the side. Natural micro-movements — slight hair movement from breeze, fabric of bikini top shifting with breath.
0-2s.speech_direction: Warm, casual, affectionate — like calling a pet. Slight pause between 'baby' and 'come here'. Not loud — conversational volume, intimate tone. Lips move naturally, jaw relaxed.

2-6s.action: Adult male lion with full thick mane walks slowly into frame from the left side — large, heavy, natural gait, paws landing with weight. Lion approaches her lounger and lowers its large head toward her torso and shoulder area. She reacts with immediate genuine delight — eyes widening, smile breaking naturally, body shifting toward the lion. Her hand reaches out and begins stroking the lion's mane — fingers pressing into the thick fur, hand moving in a slow natural rubbing motion along the side of the mane and behind the ear. Her other arm wraps loosely around the lion's neck. Natural weight transfer — the lion's presence causes the lounger to shift slightly, her body adjusting. Lion's tail moves slowly. Lion exhales — slight nostril flare visible.
2-6s.direction: The woman's reaction must look completely natural and unsurprised — she knows this lion. Not fearful, not performative excitement. The hand rubbing the mane is the most important physical detail — fingers visibly pressing into fur with real contact, not hovering. Her face turns toward the lion briefly then back toward camera.

6-12s.action: She turns her face back toward the camera — now holding the phone up or looking directly at the lens, lion's large head resting against her shoulder or chest, mane filling the left side of frame. Her hand continues slow rhythmic strokes on the lion's mane throughout — never stops. Expression is playful and warm, eyebrows raised slightly, smile natural and asymmetric. Free hand gestures loosely toward the lion on 'you'. At the end of the line she glances at the lion with a fond expression then back to camera. The lion shifts its head slightly — natural animal movement, blinks slowly, nostril flare. Bright sun catches the lion's mane — warm golden tones in the fur. Breeze moves loose strands of her hair.
6-12s.script: Look — we're live right now, and they really wanna see you… say hello.
6-12s.speech_direction: Playful, warm, slightly conspiratorial — like she's showing off her best friend. 'Look' said directly to camera with eyebrow raise. Slight pause before 'say hello', eyes flicking to lion on 'you'. Ends with a soft laugh or smile breaking through on 'say hello'.

Two snap-transitions follow: the first equips the helmet, the second equips the full plugsuit. Preserve her exact body proportions, seated pose, room, gaming chair, and lighting throughout the entire clip — only the helmet and bodysuit are ever added, nothing else changes. The plugsuit's colorway must match the helmet in EVERY point: uniform aged metallic red-and-silver with chipped, scratched battle-worn paint and a matte metallic sheen across the entire suit, with no separate accent colors anywhere — no green chest stripe, no white connector ports. The illustrated character sheet is used for panel-line shape only; none of its coloring (not even accent details) carries over.

0-1s.action: She sits in the gaming chair exactly as in the reference photo — no helmet, no suit, just the dress and stockings, phone held up for the mirror-selfie framing. Natural micro-movements, relaxed posture, casual energy establishing the 'before' state clearly before anything changes.
0-1s.direction: Short and clean — this beat only needs to register 'normal girl, normal fit' before the first snap. Don't let it drag.

1-2s.action: Her free hand snaps once at chest height. On the exact snap frame, a fast 2-3 frame white-orange light bloom sweeps across her head and shoulders. When it clears, the weathered metallic red-and-silver helmet is on her head, visor down, exactly matching Photo 3.
1-2s.direction: First hard cut. Same mechanic as the second transition later — establishes the visual language early so the second snap reads as a continuation, not a new idea. Body, chair, and framing do not move.

2-5s.action: She holds the pose with the helmet on, visor concealing her face. Small chair swivel, subtle head tilt toward the camera, free hand drifts back down near her chest, fingers relaxed and about to snap again. Tension visibly builds toward the second transition.
2-5s.direction: This is the anticipation beat for the costume reveal — treat it like the 'before' half of a TikTok outfit-transition edit, unhurried, confident.

5-6s.action: Second snap of the free hand at chest height. Same 2-3 frame white-orange light bloom sweeps across her full seated body — not a slow dissolve.
5-6s.direction: Hard cut sold by the light flash and a synced snap/whoosh cue. Chair, framing, and lighting must not shift across the cut — only the outfit beneath the neck changes.

6-10s.action: She is now in the complete plugsuit, uniformly colour-matched to the helmet's weathered metallic red-and-silver finish across every panel — no green stripe, no white connectors, no accent colors of any kind — seated in the identical cross-legged pose in the same chair. Helmet is unchanged from the first transition. Camera does a subtle 5-8% push-in for payoff. Free hand returns to hold the phone up, completing the selfie framing. Small confident chair swivel to sell the reveal since her face stays hidden behind the visor. Hold the pose through the outro.
6-10s.direction: Final reveal payoff — suit must read as cut from the exact same material as the helmet, continuous at the neckline, no visible seam, no accent colors, no color mismatch anywhere.
